title: Renascence Editions (University of Oregon / Luminarium mirror)
institution: Risa Stephanie Bear, University of Oregon (hosted by Luminarium)
region: England, with some Scotland, Wales and North America
notes: Online repository of works printed in English between 1477 and 1799, sorted by author (222 titles in all). The part dating from 1450-1700 is the large majority: sixteenth- and seventeenth-century poetry, drama, prose, proclamations and pamphlets (for example Bacon, Spenser, Dekker, Elizabeth I's proclamations, 1640s-50s pamphlets). Later items (Defoe, Fielding, Gay, Goldsmith, Gray, American colonial documents of 1775-76) fall outside the period. Texts are keyed from the original or later facsimile editions in original spelling; each is a plain HTML page, with PDF copies at the University of Oregon Scholars Bank. No bulk download. The counts cover the in-period HTML texts of the index, one record per page or part. Status: the site states '222 titles; updated November 21, 2009', and nothing newer was found (page checked 2026-10-13); the host's robots.txt allows crawling except /cgi-bin. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: Index page: 'These publications are provided for nonprofit purposes only; unique site content is copyright 1992-2009 the editors and The University of Oregon.' No open licence; the texts are free to read but reuse is limited to nonprofit purposes.
